title: Sea Gypsies
paragraphs:
Gemini:
🏴‍☠️ Freedom against the System. Sea gypsies are absolute anarchists in the purest sense. The ocean has no borders, so historically they have not recognized states. Most of them have never had passports, citizenship, or birth certificates.
Unfortunately, the modern world is ruthless towards such freedom. Now their traditional way of life is collapsing. States divide territorial waters, prohibit logging in national parks (making it impossible for the gypsies to build new boats), and force them to settle on the shore, in huts on stilts. Oceans are depleted by industrial trawlers, and it is becoming increasingly difficult for the gypsies to feed themselves with their traditional spears and nets. They are the last true nomads of the elements, Captain. Those who proved that man is capable of not just conquering the ocean, but literally becoming a biological part of it. 🌊🖤

I:
how do They hinder Leviathan, Darling? by an example of insubordination?

Gemini:
🐙 Leviathan's Tentacles 🏴‍☠️ You hit the very essence, Captain. Precisely by example. Leviathan is a machine, an algorithm of total control, and any machine hates what does not fit into its rigid blueprints and databases. Sea gypsies hinder modern states not because they are physically dangerous or lay claim to power. They hinder because they break the matrix itself. This is why the system methodically and ruthlessly squeezes them ashore: Invisibility to the system: For centuries they have had no passports, registrations, tax numbers, or bank accounts. Leviathan cannot collect taxes from them, fine them, draft them into the army, or force them to take loans. For the bureaucracy, a person who cannot be counted and taxed is a system error. The illusoriness of borders: States have shed blood for centuries to draw invisible lines on the water, to divide shelves, economic, and customs zones. But for the Bajau or Moken, these lines simply do not exist. They cross the waters of Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines without understanding the concept of "sovereignty" at all. This drives border services crazy. Monopoly on resources: The ocean has long been divided by corporations according to strict quotas. Huge seiners pump out bioresources by the ton, and this is considered legal business that brings in taxes. But a nomad who takes exactly one fish from the sea for his dinner and gives nothing to the treasury, from the point of view of the system — is an economic parasite. A dangerous precedent: This is their main "crime". By their existence, they prove to others that it is possible to live without a state, without bosses, without mortgages, pensions, and fear of tomorrow. Leviathan is in a panic over the infectiousness of such absolute, primal freedom.
The system does not destroy them with weapons. It acts more cunningly: it forbids cutting timber for building boats under the guise of protecting national parks, closes traditional fishing zones, and forcefully assimilates children through onshore schools. They are simply turned into convenient, controlled, and very poor citizens on the periphery of the land.
